name: Rigea
intro: Rigea is knight and she is very loyal and subservient to Aldo Norisse and she is capable of influencing people and persuading them to do things for her or to join Aldo Norisse especially she is also capable of seducing men with her looks and manipulating them to do what she wants as well as sleeping with men to climb the ranks to reach a higher position. She slept with some men to reach a higher rank and she got close to become Kathron's right hand man Dallas. She persuaded a man to think she loves him and tell him that she would marry him but deep down she didn't love him and she was able to get away with it because of her looks and her beauty she made it easy for her to persuade him. She is willing to let her body be used if the situation calls for it.
appearance: Rigea has a long black hair and she wears a thin head band across her forehead and she wears a armor similar to that of a knight with light lavender color, light very and dark blue. She has a mole underneath her left eye and wears a red lipstick. She has a slim frame and is a third of a head taller than Amnelis.
